named_method: Supervised binary merge prediction with condition-aware evaluation and explicit interpretability
definition: Train discriminative models on 20 input features to predict same-neuron vs different-neuron labels
Tune on training data only using cross-validation or validation splits
Evaluate once on held-out test data
Report both overall and degradation-specific performance
Provide post hoc interpretability beyond raw metric reporting
assumptions: Provided train/test split is trusted and non-overlapping
Feature columns 0-19 are normalized engineered descriptors
Degradation is a stratification variable and should not be collapsed away during reporting
invariants: No use of test labels for fitting or threshold tuning beyond reporting unless explicitly documented
Use the same core metric set across compared models
